summary: workoutDetailRideID (internal/cli/offline.go) treats Peloton's freestyle sentinel ride id ("00000000000000000000000000000000", 32 zeros -- used for Just Run/Just Ride/Outdoor/other non-class workouts) as equivalent to no ride id at all, returning "" for both cases. offline_intervals and offline_repeat both consume this helper and now correctly treat a freestyle workout as having no class association, rather than treating the sentinel as a genuine (and, when two freestyle workouts share the identical sentinel, spuriously matching) class id. Caveat wording at both call sites was also corrected from language implying a sync gap ("class structure is unavailable", "lack a comparable class identifier") to language stating the actual fact ("not class-based"). Any future regen or new consumer of workout_details' ride id must route through workoutDetailRideID, never a direct stringValue/objectValue read, or the sentinel bug reappears.
reason: NEW DEFECT from a sixth live post-fix verification sweep (a round-6 addendum after issue G was independently confirmed resolved via a real workout_details backfill, and offline_strength/offline_repeat were confirmed working on the happy path): confirmed live that 84 of 430 synced workout_details records on the real account carry this exact sentinel, and offline_repeat reported same_class:true for two explicitly unrelated freestyle workouts ("64 min 39 sec Outdoor Running" and "28 min Just Run") sharing only the sentinel value -- a false positive affecting up to 84*83/2 = 3486 spurious pairs on this one account. offline_intervals's caveat for the same underlying condition read as a sync/data gap rather than the true "this workout was never a class" fact.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. New test TestOfflineIntervalsAndRepeatTreatFreestyleSentinelAsNoClass confirms both commands correctly treat the sentinel as no-class and never leak the raw sentinel value into output. Existing TestOfflineIntervalsAndRepeatResolveNestedRideID updated for the corrected caveat wording. Live-verified against the exact two real workouts cited in the report: offline_repeat now correctly returns same_class:false with an accurate caveat, and offline_intervals now correctly reports "not class-based" instead of the misleading "stored class structure is unavailable".
